ops.text: On a Sprite, every relayed drive verb (drive pr add, drive job set --repro, even drive pr add --help) printed 'no answer in 9 minutes from the coordinator's Mac' and exited 0, then the answer arrived as a separate orca orchestration message tens of minutes later. Exit 0 on no answer reads as success to a script, and the lane cannot tell a late success from a lost command without waiting on an unrelated message. The relay should exit nonzero on no answer, or name the orchestration message that will carry the result.
